data.narrative:
Mammoth Biosciences is a Series D-stage biotech company founded by Jennifer Doudna and colleagues, having raised $465M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies in the Biotech & Health sector, with particular focus on 3 same-sector, adjacent-stage private peers: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B Series C).

Two methods triangulate valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x multiplier to the $465M total-raised proxy, implying $698M. Peer-median analysis references the 3-company private comparables, which show a median valuation of $3.8B (range $3.1B–$10.3B). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (7.4x sector median) cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures, standard for private companies. The two applicable methods produce a low of $593M, median of $2.2B, and high of $4.4B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.2B–$4.4B, with material uncertainty driven by peer dispersion—particularly the $10.3B outlier—and stage positioning. Stage-progression implies a more conservative floor; peer medians suggest upside. Key unknowns include Mammoth's proprietary asset value relative to peers and capital efficiency trajectory pre-Series E.
